author: Claude (implementing in place of Codex at Omri's request, 2026-10-06)
scope: Development presentation panels on the already exposed PRMBench/ProcessBench population. Descriptive; not a locked recipe; not untouched confirmation.
exposure_disclosure: Before this protocol, the Claude review of results/monday_fusion_competitor_extension_v1/run_20261006 (REVIEW.md) had already seen: all 4-method x 8-bank METRICS, category and contrast tables; supervised PRM and MTG within-AUC / top-k PRMScore on PRMBench; ProcessBench argmax hit rates for the 4 methods, MTG, Qwen2.5-Math-PRM-7B and the Qwen-72B critic by subset/position/length; and the step-0 / longest-step baselines. Every table built here is therefore post hoc with respect to those numbers.

omri_decisions_2026-10-06.method_presentation: Unlocked panel: the 4 registered methods are shown together with controls; no winner and no lock.
omri_decisions_2026-10-06.highlight: Highlight the best relevant bank as the candidate configuration; show the other banks as well but less prominently.
omri_decisions_2026-10-06.external: Separate protocol (not this file): label-free refit on target, full panel (4 methods x 8 banks + equal controls + step index).

highlight_rule.rule: Bank with the highest mean PRMBench within-answer AUC over the 4 registered methods (PRMBench is primary per the 2026-09-23 decision).
highlight_rule.label: Post hoc selection on development data. B16 includes the 3 digit channels approved on 2026-09-29; B13 is the best digit-free bank and is reported beside it.
highlight_rule.use_for_external: This highlight is fixed before any external result of the Monday methods is opened, so the external panel can test whether the development choice transfers.

roster_note: This 4-method roster comes from Codex's competitor extension (drops HEM_MOM_ga, adds TCI_ONLY_ga). No record shows Omri choosing it; HEM_MOM_ga is reported in Panel A from the candidate panel scores for completeness.

A_algorithm.question: Does the fusion algorithm add value over simple fusion of the SAME bank?
A_algorithm.secondary_metric: ProcessBench argmax first-error hit (cell-equal mean over 8 cells)
A_algorithm.contrasts: each method minus DS_FILTER_EQ and minus ALL_EQ, per bank; paired source-group bootstrap

B_detector.question: How does the method compare with competitors as an error localizer?
B_detector.highlight: B16 (all 4 methods shown); other banks in a secondary table

competitors.supervised_PRM: Qwen2.5-Math-PRM-7B (frozen PRMBench metadata rewards/labels; dataset_cache/four_localization/pb_prm_qwen25math7b_full for ProcessBench)
competitors.critic: Qwen2.5-72B critic predictions on ProcessBench (dataset_cache/four_localization/pb_critic_qwen72b_full); no PRMBench run exists
competitors.mind_the_gap: Frozen local teacher-forced reproduction (EVIDENCE_DROP.npz step_m5, EMA span 5, worst-5 mean, native argmax). Not the paper's code or numbers.

baselines: step index (later step = riskier) for within-AUC

PRMBench_metrics.threshold_free: within-answer AUC; top-1 step is an annotated error
PRMBench_metrics.equal_budget: PRMScore with top-1 flagged step per answer (fair to thresholds); top-2 reported and labelled post hoc
PRMBench_metrics.own_rule: PRMScore at each scorer's own rule (ours ANSWER_Z_Q80; PRM native labels==0 at 0.5); different calibration access, labelled
PRMBench_metrics.decomposition: F1 on correct steps and F1 on error steps
PRMBench_metrics.error_types: the 9 PRMBench classifications and 3 categories (within-AUC and top-1 PRMScore)

ProcessBench_metrics.gate_free: argmax first-error hit on erroneous answers (the Mind the Gap protocol)
ProcessBench_metrics.strata: subset, error position, answer length, and a 'content-only' stratum: first error neither at step 0 nor in the longest step
ProcessBench_metrics.own_rule: official F1 under R2_COUNT and ENTROPY_GATE_Q80 for ours vs PRM native threshold 0.5 and the critic; different access, labelled

B_detector.contrasts: B16 methods minus MTG and minus PRM on: PRMBench within-AUC, top-1 PRMScore, top-1-on-error; ProcessBench argmax hit (all and content-only stratum). Paired source-group bootstrap.

aggregation.PRMBench: per bank: mean over answers (AUC) / pooled step counts (PRMScore); multi-bank summaries are bank-equal means
aggregation.ProcessBench: headline = cell-equal mean over the 8 cells (each subset x telemetry model), matching the main table and the official per-subset convention; answer-pooled values are labelled when shown
aggregation.duplication_note: ProcessBench answers appear twice (q4 and q8 telemetry models) with the same source group.

statistics.interval: two-sided percentile 95%, descriptive, no multiplicity claim

validation: All inputs hashed in INPUT_MANIFEST.json before scoring.
Reconstructed MEAN_MOM/HEM_MOM scores equal the frozen candidate-panel score arrays (<=1e-12).
Per-bank method metrics equal run_20261006 METRICS.csv (<=1e-12); control metrics equal candidate panel CONTENT_METRICS.csv (<=1e-12).
PRM/critic ProcessBench caches align with the population (ids, step counts, labels).
claims_not_allowed: Mind the Gap paper numbers as our comparator
